title: Mom as a vinyl toy: pick a model
kaylee: Mom becomes a vinyl toy like her unicorn: same cream unicorn, glasses and smile, and her mouth moves when she talks.
questions: Model 2 or model 4? (tap "Pick this one" on a card)
The glasses and smile are drawn in code: keep them as they are?

pitches.title: Model 2
pitches.finger: Hair like the picture from the front; two little curls stick out at the nape.
grows: smile that opens when she talks
pitches.why: Eyes painted flat on her face.

pitches.title: Model 4
pitches.finger: The cleanest back: real hair locks over the back of her head, no stray curls.
grows: smile that opens when she talks
pitches.why: Glossy sculpted eyes, like your unicorn's.
